title: First Tree Interactive Scroll Guide V1.2 — existing first-journey revision
productJob: A new returning user (or a sample demo path) lands at LoveTree First Journey, experiences the continuous sticky-scroll V1.2 walkthrough, discovers the First Moment, scrolls forward to see three next candidates with editable WHY NEXT, decides MAIN or BRANCH, and sees YOUR FIRST TREE · MAIN + BRANCH before completing the discovery flow. This is a presentation delta of the existing /v4/journey surface, not a new Lineage.
summary: Track66 (퓨스트트리 인터랙티브 스크롤가이드 V1.2 / First Tree Interactive Scroll Guide V1.2) is a CANONICAL_OWNER_CAPABILITY of the existing /v4/journey route. Unlike the V1 page-by-page wizard, V1.2 uses a continuous sticky-scroll paradigm: one same miniature morphs into a world view, forward/reverse scroll reveals the First Moment and three next candidates, editable WHY NEXT labels, MAIN/BRANCH routing, and YOUR FIRST TREE · MAIN + BRANCH finale. API/DB/Auth = NON-SCOPE. State uses localStorage (source/presentation proof only, not durable persistence). Existing V1 journey regression tests remain unchanged.
sourceDefects: source executable uses JS-based scroll-driven animations — native implementation will use CSS scroll-driven animations where available, IntersectionObservers for step detection, and React state for morph/modal transitions
nativeRemediations: continuous sticky scroll: viewport-anchored hero maintains position while content cards scroll behind
miniature→world morph: initial card smoothly scales and repositions into full hero view on first scroll
forward + reverse: scroll direction detection drives step progression and regression
First Moment: prominent initial card with metadata
next candidates: 3 horizontally arranged cards after First Moment
editable WHY NEXT: inline text field per connection
MAIN / BRANCH: radio/toggle for path selection per next candidate
YOUR FIRST TREE · MAIN + BRANCH: recap summary with tree visualization placeholder

adoption.note: Issue #177 — V1.2 continuous-scroll first journey accepted as presentation delta of existing /v4/journey. Native presentation implementation complete. API/DB/Auth = NON-SCOPE. Canonical durable persistence (Issue #204) is a separate concern.

notes: Existing V1 journey tests at tests/v4-first-journey-source-faithful.test.mjs remain unchanged (regression gate).
No new Lineage number allocated — existing /v4/journey route is the canonical owner.
This is a presentation delta, not a new database model or API handler.
